Actually, my heart's been pounding for a
while.

like I just finished a really
intense
workout.

text_block_list.text:
Ngh...
I'm starting to feel a little unsure.
Does
that mean I haven't trained
enough?

pounding?

text_block_list.text:

just
because I'm scared. They're shaking
because...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: They're really excited and ready to go!
